description: Answers 'what are the best published strategies on the FinzData Hub?' Optionally sort by benchmark (full record re-run nightly through today; strategies beating their benchmark on return and Sharpe first), robust (deflated Sharpe), forward (forward Sharpe, 63+ days out-of-sample), new or forks; optionally filter by family (momentum, expr, ma_cross, factor) and limit. Returns the matching public strategies; each item carries vs_benchmark, the full-record verdict. Use get_strategy for one strategy's full spec and record.
name: list_strategies
title: List hub strategies
